decision.rationale: The official UBC Wine Research Centre describes a Canadian grape and wine industry research and education mandate, with public research, facilities and education sections. Its Kelowna address does not limit the stated Canada-wide mission to Okanagan campus services. Education routes separately from research, and contact guidance supplies support; no additional category is strongly evidenced by this homepage.
evidence: https://wine.ubc.ca/ | e895dc218528b6fe9ff9c88342f557c029263e8ee6ac243146fc1ff809f0c6f4 | The Wine Research Centre (WRC) is the focal point for grape and wine industry research and education at The University of British Columbia (UBC).

https://wine.ubc.ca/ | e895dc218528b6fe9ff9c88342f557c029263e8ee6ac243146fc1ff809f0c6f4 | Our core mission is to support the development of a sustainable and effective Canadian grape and wine industry through world-class research, excellence in wine education, practical solutions and knowledge mobilization.

https://wine.ubc.ca/ | e895dc218528b6fe9ff9c88342f557c029263e8ee6ac243146fc1ff809f0c6f4 | Navigation: Research /research/; Facilities /research/facilities/; Education /education/; Undergraduate /education/undergraduate-programs/; Graduate /education/graduate-programs/; Extended Education /education/extended-education/; Contact /contact/

rules.rationale: The education section explicitly covers undergraduate, graduate and extended education programs.
The research section and its facilities subsection describe the centre's research activity and infrastructure.
The contact section helps readers reach the centre.

fallback.rationale: The Wine Research Centre primarily presents UBC research and knowledge mobilization for the Canadian grape and wine industry.
